description: This file defines an enumeration 'GatewayConnectionIssue' representing different connection issues for a Gateway, including methods to detect and extract specific information from status texts related to connection problems.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Static method that analyzes a status text string to determine and categorize the connection issue.

methods.name: extractRequestId
methods.description: Private static method to extract a request ID from a status text, used internally by 'detect'.
